entities.name: DL Information Transfer Procedure
entities.description: Procedure to transfer NAS dedicated information from NG-RAN to UE in RRC_CONNECTED or RRC_INACTIVE during SDT, or to transfer F1-C related information from IAB Donor-CU to IAB-DU via IAB-MT in RRC_CONNECTED.

entities.name: DLInformationTransfer
entities.description: RRC message used to transfer NAS dedicated information or F1-C related information from network to UE.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE has an established RRC connection with the network.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC state where UE is inactive but maintains some connection context.

entities.name: During SDT
entities.description: Condition indicating the procedure occurs during Small Data Transmission.

entities.name: NAS dedicated information
entities.description: NAS layer information transferred from NG-RAN to UE.

entities.name: F1-C related information
entities.description: F1 control plane information transferred from IAB Donor-CU to IAB-DU via IAB-MT.

relations.description: The DL Information Transfer procedure uses the DLInformationTransfer message as its main signaling step.
The procedure can be performed when UE is in RRC_CONNECTED state.
The procedure can be performed when UE is in RRC_INACTIVE state during SDT.
The procedure execution for RRC_INACTIVE UE is guarded by the SDT condition.
The DLInformationTransfer message carries NAS dedicated information.
The DLInformationTransfer message carries F1-C related information for IAB scenarios.
